scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree” (preprints/Deterministic-nonbipartite-Ramanujan-graphs-in-every-fixed-degree-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 178 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d8ea4bb85aae750), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer d ≥ 3 there are constants n0(d) and kd and a deterministic algorithm with the following property. On input an even integer n ≥ n0(d), the algorithm outputs the adjacency list of a simple d-regular graph G on n vertices in Od(nkd ) bit operations, and −2 √ d − 1 < λ < 2 √ d − 1 for every eigenvalue λ of AG|1⊥ . In particular, G is connected and nonbipartite.
